author: reek
body: Occlusion queries as a depth-complexity visualisation. The camera ray passes through a rotating field of translucent spheres; one thread per pixel counts how many spheres the ray enters (the overdraw / occlusion count) and maps that count to a heat colour -- blue where one surface is visible, through green and yellow to red where many overlap. That per-pixel count is exactly what a hardware occlusion query aggregates. Reference site's "occlusion queries" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.
